1º de Primaria · Inglés · Tema 8

Clothes and weather

Nombre: ______________________   Fecha: ___________

Qué vas a aprender

  • Name clothes: T-shirt, trousers, skirt, dress, shoes, coat, hat
  • Say what I'm wearing: I'm wearing a…
  • Name the weather: sunny, rainy, cloudy, windy, snowy
  • Ask and answer What's the weather like?
  • Choose the right clothes for the weather

Para pensar

Look out of the window. Is it sunny or rainy today? What clothes are you wearing?

Explicación

1. My clothes

We wear clothes every day.

This is a T-shirt. These are trousers. These are shoes.

Clothes keep us warm and clean. What are you wearing today?

2. Skirt, dress and socks

More clothes: a skirt, a dress and socks.

Anybody can wear any clothes. Wear what you like and what is comfortable.

Socks go on our feet, inside our shoes. One sock, two socks!

3. Coat, hat and scarf

When it is cold, we wear a coat, a hat and a scarf.

We can also wear gloves on our hands and boots on our feet.

Brrr! Winter clothes keep us warm.

4. I'm wearing…

To say what clothes we have on, we say I'm wearing…

I'm wearing a red T-shirt. I'm wearing blue trousers.

Remember: the colour goes before the clothes. Look at your clothes and say what you are wearing!

5. The weather

The weather changes every day.

Today it can be sunny, cloudy or rainy.

To ask, we say: What's the weather like? We answer: It's sunny!

6. Windy and snowy

More weather words: windy and snowy.

When it's windy, the trees move and kites fly high.

When it's snowy, everything is white. We can make a snowman! And with a storm, there is thunder.

7. Hot and cold

In summer it is hot. In winter it is cold.

When it's hot, we say I'm hot! and drink water.

When it's cold, we say I'm cold! and put on a coat. How do you feel today?

8. Clothes for the weather

We choose clothes for the weather.

It's sunny: I wear a T-shirt, shorts and a cap.

It's rainy: I wear a raincoat and boots, and I take an umbrella. It's cold: I wear a coat, a hat and a scarf.

9. The seasons

There are four seasons: spring, summer, autumn and winter.

In spring there are flowers. In summer it's hot. In autumn the leaves fall. In winter it's cold.

What's your favourite season?

10. Put on, take off

When we get dressed, we put on our clothes. Put on your coat!

When it's hot, we take off our jumper. Take off your hat!

Can you put on your shoes by yourself? Great!

11. Game: dress the bear

Play dress the bear. Draw a big bear on paper.

Roll a dice. Look at the weather card: sunny, rainy or snowy.

Choose clothes for your bear and say: It's rainy. The bear is wearing a raincoat and boots!

12. Review: clothes and weather

Now you know clothes: T-shirt, trousers, skirt, dress, shoes, coat and hat.

You know the weather: sunny, cloudy, rainy, windy and snowy.

You can say I'm wearing… and What's the weather like? Brilliant!

What's the weather like?

Ejercicios

  1. Point to your shoes and say: shoes.

  2. Draw a T-shirt and colour it.

  3. Draw a sun and write: sunny.

  4. Draw a cloud with rain and write: rainy.

  5. Match: abrigo – coat, gorro – hat.

  6. Is it hot or cold in winter?

  7. Put on your coat! (mime)

  8. Say three clothes in English.

  9. Complete: I'm wearing a ____ T-shirt.

  10. Answer: What's the weather like today?

  11. It's rainy. What do you need?

  12. Write two clothes for a hot day.

  13. Write two clothes for a cold day.

  14. Complete: In winter it's ____. In summer it's ____.

  15. Order the seasons: winter, spring, autumn, summer.

  16. Describe a friend's clothes: He's / She's wearing…

  17. Make a weather chart for one week with drawings.

  18. Play «dress the bear» with weather cards.

  19. Pack a suitcase for the beach: write five things.

  20. Pack a suitcase for the mountains in winter: write five things.

  21. Be a weather presenter: «Good morning! Today it's…».

  22. Describe your favourite season and the clothes you wear.

Practica

  1. «Camiseta» in English is…

    1. A) trousers
    2. B) T-shirt
    3. C) skirt

  2. «Zapatos» in English is…

    1. A) shoes
    2. B) socks
    3. C) hats

  3. We wear a coat when it's…

    1. A) hot
    2. B) sunny
    3. C) cold

  4. There is a big sun. It's…

    1. A) rainy
    2. B) snowy
    3. C) sunny

  5. Water falls from the clouds. It's…

    1. A) windy
    2. B) rainy
    3. C) hot

  6. Everything is white. It's…

    1. A) snowy
    2. B) cloudy
    3. C) sunny

  7. What's the weather like? →

    1. A) It's windy
    2. B) It's a hat
    3. C) I'm six

  8. When it's rainy we take an…

    1. A) ice cream
    2. B) apple
    3. C) umbrella

  9. I'm wearing…

    1. A) red a dress
    2. B) a red dress
    3. C) a dress red

  10. The hot season is…

    1. A) winter
    2. B) summer
    3. C) autumn

  11. «Gorro» in English is…

    1. A) coat
    2. B) scarf
    3. C) hat

  12. Trees move and kites fly. It's…

    1. A) windy
    2. B) snowy
    3. C) sunny

Explícalo con tus palabras

Incluye: How to say what clothes I'm wearing; How to ask and answer about the weather; Which clothes go with each kind of weather.

Resumen

Glosario

Clothes
Things we wear, like T-shirts and shoes (ropa).
T-shirt
A top with short sleeves (camiseta).
Trousers
Clothes for your legs (pantalones).
Coat
A warm thing to wear outside (abrigo).
Hat
A thing to wear on your head (gorro, sombrero).
Weather
How the sky and the air are today (tiempo).
Sunny
With a lot of sun (soleado).
Rainy
With rain (lluvioso).
Snowy
With snow (nevado).
Umbrella
A thing to stop the rain (paraguas).

Tarjetas de repaso

Recórtalas: pregunta delante, respuesta detrás.

PantalonesTrousers

¿Qué tiempo hace?What's the weather like?
Llevo…I'm wearing…

Soluciones

  1. B) T-shirt.
  2. A) Shoes.
  3. C) Cold.
  4. C) Sunny.
  5. B) Rainy.
  6. A) Snowy.
  7. A) It's + weather.
  8. C) Umbrella.
  9. B) Colour first.
  10. B) Summer.
  11. C) Hat.
  12. A) Windy.

Soluciones de los ejercicios

  1. Shoes.
  2. A T-shirt in any colour.
  3. A sun and the word «sunny».
  4. A cloud with drops and the word «rainy».
  5. Coat = abrigo; hat = gorro.
  6. Cold.
  7. The child mimes putting on a coat.
  8. For example, T-shirt, trousers, shoes.
  9. Free answer, for example: blue.
  10. It's sunny / cloudy / rainy… (free answer).
  11. An umbrella, a raincoat and boots.
  12. T-shirt, shorts (or cap, dress).
  13. Coat, hat (or scarf, gloves, boots).
  14. cold; hot.
  15. Spring, summer, autumn, winter.
  16. Free answer.
  17. Free answer: one drawing each day.
  18. Free answer, for example: It's snowy. The bear is wearing a coat.
  19. For example: T-shirt, shorts, cap, swimsuit, sun cream.
  20. For example: coat, hat, scarf, gloves, boots.
  21. Free answer.
  22. Free answer, for example: My favourite season is summer. I wear a T-shirt.
